MirrorOS installation plan (format 3)
================================================================================

1. Target
=========
  Architecture      x86_64
  Memory            4294967296 bytes (4.0 GiB)
  Virtualization    kvm
  System vendor     QEMU
  Product name      Standard PC (Q35 + ICH9, 2009)
  Profile           matched reference-vm (recognized profile; not a
                    qualification of this machine)
  Disk path         /dev/vda
  Disk by-id        virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
  Serial            SYNTH-VDA-0001
  Size              34359738368 bytes (32.0 GiB)

  DESTRUCTIVE: every partition and all data on this disk will be erased.

  Current layout (this content will be destroyed):
    Partition table   gpt 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
    /dev/vda1  536870912 bytes (512.0 MiB); vfat; label SYNTH-ESP
    /dev/vda2  32212254720 bytes (30.0 GiB); ext4; label SYNTH-DATA

3. Destructive operations
=========================
  DESTRUCTIVE wipe_disk_signatures
      Remove existing filesystem and partition-table signatures from the target
      disk.
  DESTRUCTIVE create_partition_table
      Write an empty GPT on the target disk.
  DESTRUCTIVE create_partitions
      Create the ESP and a root partition on the remaining space.
  DESTRUCTIVE format_filesystems
      Format the ESP as FAT32 and the root partition with the selected
      filesystem.

4. Operations in order
======================
  01. wipe_disk_signatures DESTRUCTIVE
      Remove existing filesystem and partition-table signatures from the target
      disk.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
  02. create_partition_table DESTRUCTIVE
      Write an empty GPT on the target disk.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
      table: gpt
  03. create_partitions DESTRUCTIVE
      Create the ESP and a root partition on the remaining space.
      disk: virtio-SYNTH-VDA-0001
      esp_size_bytes: 2147483648
      esp_mount_point: /boot
      root: remaining_space
  04. format_filesystems DESTRUCTIVE
      Format the ESP as FAT32 and the root partition with the selected
      filesystem.
      esp_filesystem: vfat
      root_filesystem: ext4
      resolved at apply: partition_uuids (blkid)
  05. mount_target
      Mount the root filesystem and the ESP under the target root.
      esp_mount_point: /boot
  06. install_packages
      Install the base package set, zram-generator, and the packages of the
      storage option.
      packages: base, linux, linux-firmware, zram-generator, sudo, neovim,
        man-db, man-pages, networkmanager
  07. configure_zram
      Deliver the zram-generator drop-in: one zram device sized to memory,
      compressed with zstd, as preferred swap.
      destination: /usr/lib/systemd/zram-generator.conf.d/60-mirroros.conf
      source_sha256:
        b6aa35ad3b4ee26a9296a50a45f215fd7e008fff05ad2fdbde67ba2a7f55f9cd
      zram_size: ram
      compression_algorithm: zstd
      swap_priority: 100
  08. configure_memory_reclaim
      Deliver the sysctl drop-in with the memory reclaim settings.
      destination: /usr/lib/sysctl.d/60-mirroros-memory.conf
      source_sha256:
        efa0ad6cc81d44518d21a8c9eca61635ca7dbacc55463d01ae74cded970ac678
      vm.swappiness: 180
      vm.page-cluster: 0
      vm.watermark_scale_factor: 125
      vm.watermark_boost_factor: 0
  09. generate_fstab
      Generate /etc/fstab by UUID.
      identifier: uuid
  10. create_swapfile
      Create the swapfile with fallback swap priority 0 and list it in fstab; it
      also holds the hibernation image.
      path: /swapfile
      size_mib: 4096
      priority: 0
      resolved at apply: resume_offset (filefrag)
  11. configure_locale_time_console
      Configure locales, language, console keymap, time zone, hardware clock,
      and time sync.
      locales: en_US.UTF-8
      lang: en_US.UTF-8
      locale_categories: LANG=en_US.UTF-8; LC_TIME=en_US.UTF-8;
        LC_NUMERIC=en_US.UTF-8; LC_MONETARY=en_US.UTF-8;
        LC_MEASUREMENT=en_US.UTF-8
      console_keymap: us
      timezone: Europe/Madrid
      hardware_clock: utc
      time_sync: systemd-timesyncd
  12. configure_hostname_network
      Set the hostname and configure NetworkManager without predefined
      connections.
      hostname: mirroros-ref
      network_manager: NetworkManager
  13. create_user
      Create the user account and set its password from a protected prompt.
      user_name: mirroros
      groups: wheel
      shell: bash
  14. configure_root_account
      Configure the root account as selected.
      mode: locked
  15. configure_sudo_sysrq_pacman
      Install the sudoers drop-in, the sysrq setting, and the pacman options.
      sudoers: %wheel ALL=(ALL:ALL) ALL
      sysrq: kernel.sysrq = 1
      pacman_options: Color, ParallelDownloads = 5, VerbosePkgLists, ILoveCandy
  16. install_bootloader
      Install and configure the boot loader and the kernel command line.
      bootloader: systemd-boot
      kernel_cmdline: root=UUID=<root> rw zswap.enabled=0 resume=UUID=<root>
        resume_offset=<resume_offset>
      options: timeout=3; editor=false; fallback_entry=true
      resolved at apply: root_uuid (blkid)
      resolved at apply: resume_offset (filefrag)
  17. enable_services
      Enable the network, time sync, trim, and storage option services.
      services: NetworkManager, systemd-timesyncd, fstrim.timer

5. Secret requirements
======================
  Only names are recorded. Values are never stored in the plan.

  account_password
    Purpose           Password of the created user account, shared with the root
                      account when root password access is enabled.
    Required by       create_user
    Channel           protected_prompt
    Provenance        technical_necessity
